profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ describes itself as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment. Its website presents the Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform as making AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale. The company says its product and service portfolio supports AI, analytics, and cloud solutions, and that it partners with leading providers.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Diego, CA, with ticker TDC and CIK 0000816761. Available records show 281 law exposure entries in California. No specific products or MCP servers are listed in the available records, and no cases are listed.
